Flytower 1.4.3 makes the help more helpful. On the website, the docs pages show labelled screenshots of the panel. Inside the panel, **Show me** goes to the button or setting a help page talks about and lights it up, **Do it** presses a few safe ones for you (Back up now, Start, Restart, Stop and Copy address) through their usual confirm and passkey check, and help shows your own details, such as the address players join with.

Nothing changes for your servers, and there's nothing to do after updating. Testing notes are in [#271](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/pull/271), [#272](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/pull/272) and [#273](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/pull/273).
